AUTH_OPERATOR_SECRET.description: Generate a private bootstrap credential with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

AUTH_ORIGIN.description: Exact HTTPS origin without a path or trailing slash, for example `https://reader.example.com`.

FEED_REFRESH_QUEUE_NAME.description: Must exactly match the Queue configured for FEED_REFRESH_QUEUE. Keep both default names or change both together.

OPML_IMPORT_QUEUE_NAME.description: Must exactly match the Queue configured for OPML_IMPORT_QUEUE. Keep both default names or change both together.

FAVICON_REFRESH_QUEUE_NAME.description: Must exactly match the Queue configured for FAVICON_REFRESH_QUEUE. Keep both default names or change both together.

FEED_REFRESH_QUEUE.description: Carries one durable feed-refresh operation ID per message. Keep its resource name synchronized with FEED_REFRESH_QUEUE_NAME.

OPML_IMPORT_QUEUE.description: Carries one durable OPML-discovery operation ID per message. Keep its resource name synchronized with OPML_IMPORT_QUEUE_NAME.

FAVICON_REFRESH_QUEUE.description: Carries one durable favicon-refresh operation ID per message. Keep its resource name synchronized with FAVICON_REFRESH_QUEUE_NAME.

DB.description: Authoritative Larafeed D1 database. All migrations are applied during deployment.
